answer: Lesson 12's Model Building text refers to a 'summative Final Explanation... marked with the four-level CBE rubric' as if a printed Parts 1 to 5 document existed, and no such document exists. Fix it once by saying plainly that the Final Explanation is the learner's individual written task in this phase, assessed with the four-level rubric in the formative assessment. Also name the partner contract as the peer-swap step. Make the rubric record each of the four levels in its own field (Exceeds, Meets, Approaches, Below), so all four CBE levels are shown consistently.
